update.mustText: This version is too old to use safely. The update is free and keeps your family's data safe.
update.mayText: Update for the latest fixes and features.
update.howIos: To update: open the App Store, search for AYWO, and tap Update.
update.howAndroid: To update: open the Play Store, search for AYWO, and tap Update.

maintenance.title: Back very soon
maintenance.text: AYWO is being improved. Please try again in a little while. Your family's data is safe.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.text: This screen stopped working. We've been told and will fix it. Your family's data is safe.
crash.stuck: Still not working? Go to Home, or start AYWO again with the second button.
crash.restartFailed: AYWO could not restart itself. Please close the app fully and open it again.

sos.label: SOS. Hold for 2 seconds to alert your family.
sos.hint: Hold for 2 seconds. Your SOS contacts hear an alarm at once.
sos.title: SOS
sos.sub: Hold 2 seconds to alert your family
sos.explain: Hold the bar for 2 seconds. A tap alone does nothing.

report.why: What's wrong? AYWO staff will look within 24 hours. The person won't know who reported it.
report.selfHarm: If someone may be in danger right now, call 112 or use SOS.
report.blockHelp: You won't see each other's memories or messages.
report.thanks: We'll look at it within 24 hours and act if it breaks the AYWO rules.
report.thanksBlocked: We'll look at it within 24 hours. {{name}} is blocked.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: You won't see each other's memories, comments or messages, and they can't start a chat with you. They aren't told.
block.unblockText: You'll see each other's memories and messages again.
block.listSubtitle: People you blocked can't chat with you, and you don't see each other's posts.

help.subtitle: Quick answers, or ask AYWO Support.
help.safetyNote: If someone is in danger now, use SOS or call 112. Support answers within a day.
help.subject: In a few words

help.replyTime: We usually answer within a day.
help.needSubject: Add a short line saying what it is about.

orders.title: My orders
orders.subtitle: Where your posters and books are.
orders.paidDone: Thank you. Your order is below, and you will get a notification at each step.
orders.paidWaiting: Your payment is being confirmed. This usually takes a few seconds, and this page refreshes by itself.
orders.paidSlow: This is taking longer than usual. If you paid, your order will show here as soon as the payment service tells us. If you did not finish paying, nothing was charged and no order was made.
orders.trackFailed: The tracking page could not open. Use the tracking number above on the courier's website.
orders.discountLine: You saved {{amount}} with an offer code.
orders.cancelText: Printing has not started, so this order can usually be stopped. We will send your request to AYWO Support. They cancel the order and send your money back the way you paid, then reply to you in Help.
orders.cancelAsked: You asked to cancel this order. AYWO Support will reply in Help.
orders.cancelTooLate: Printing has started, so this order can no longer be cancelled here. If something is wrong, use "Need help with an order?" below.

shop.title: Order a poster or book
shop.subtitle: Your family tree, printed and sent home.

about.tree_poster: A large printed poster of your family tree, with names and photos.
about.family_book: A printed book with your family tree, people and memories.

shop.name: Name
shop.addressAbroad: You'll enter the address on the secure payment page.
shop.cancelled: Payment wasn't finished. Nothing was charged.
shop.secure: Payment happens on Razorpay's or Stripe's own secure page. AYWO never sees your card or UPI details.
shop.thanks: Your payment is being confirmed. You'll get a notification at each step, and can follow it in My orders.
shop.needTree: Start a family tree first: the poster and book are printed from it.
shop.needAddress: Fill in the name, house and street, city and state to continue.
shop.needPhone: Check the phone number for the courier.
shop.notPaidTitle: We haven't seen your payment yet
shop.notPaid: If you closed the payment page without paying, nothing was charged and you can pay again below. If you did pay, do not pay again: banks can take a few minutes to tell us. Tap "I have paid. Check again".
shop.stillNotPaid: Not arrived yet. Wait a minute and check again. Your order will also show in My orders when the payment arrives.
shop.payAgainHelp: Only pay again if no money left your account. If money was taken, cancel here and tap "I have paid. Check again", so you are not charged twice.
shop.payAgainYes: No money was taken. Pay again

refer.title: Invite and earn
refer.subtitle: Bring family and friends to AYWO. You both get 30 days of AYWO Plus.
refer.message: Join our family on AYWO. Use my code {{code}} for 30 free days of AYWO Plus: {{link}}
refer.step1: 1. Share your code or link with someone new to AYWO.
refer.step2: 2. They sign up and join or build a family tree.
refer.step3: 3. You both get {{days}} days of AYWO Plus, free.
refer.gotCodeHelp: If someone invited you, type their code. It works in your first 14 days.
refer.claimed: Thanks! {{name}} invited you. Your free days start once you're in a family tree.
refer.fine: Up to 12 rewards a year. Free days are added on top of any Plus you have.
refer.needCode: Type the full code your friend gave you.

card.title: Emergency card
card.subtitle: What helpers should know if you send an SOS.
card.noteHint: For example: hearing aid, speaks Tamil only
card.who: Only the people your SOS reaches see this, while it runs and for a day after.
card.sosNote: Blood group, allergies and medicines, shown to helpers during an SOS.

prefs.offers: Send me offers and news from AYWO
prefs.offersHelp: At most a couple a week. Safety alerts and SOS always reach you, whatever you choose here.
prefs.emailCheck: Confirm {{email}} to get emails from AYWO. We send a 6-digit code.

consent.noticeTitle: Before you save: how we use your health details
consent.whatBody: Only what you type on this card: blood group, allergies, health conditions, regular medicines, and anything else you add. Every box is optional.
consent.whyBody: So the people your SOS reaches can help you safely, for example a doctor knowing your blood group or a medicine you must not be given. We use it for nothing else: no advertising, no profiling, never sold.
consent.whoBody: Only the people an SOS you send reaches, while it runs and for one day after. Not your family tree, not other members, and not our staff.
consent.howLongBody: Until you withdraw or delete your account. Withdrawing deletes the card at once.
consent.optionalBody: This is optional. SOS works the same without it.
consent.withdrawBody: Tap "Withdraw and delete" on this page or on Me, Privacy and account, My consents. It takes one tap, just like agreeing.
consent.complainBody: Write to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}. You can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
consent.agreeLabel: I have read this and agree that AYWO may keep these health details and show them to the people my SOS reaches.
consent.tickFirst: Tick "I agree" first, or leave the health boxes empty. The card is only saved with your agreement.
consent.agreedOn: You agreed to keep this card on {{date}}.
consent.hiddenUntilAgree: Your SOS helpers can't see this card yet. Read the notice below and tick "I agree" to turn it on.
consent.withdrawMessage: Your emergency card is deleted now, and SOS helpers will not see it. You can fill it in again later.

myConsents.title: My consents
myConsents.subtitle: What you agreed to, when, and how to take it back
myConsents.olderNotice: Agreed to an older notice. Open the card to read the new one; until then SOS helpers don't see it.
myConsents.neededHelp: Needed to use AYWO. To withdraw it, delete your account.
myConsents.healthHelp: Optional. Shown only to the people an SOS you send reaches. Withdrawing deletes the card.
myConsents.marketingHelp: Optional. Occasional offers and news from AYWO.
myConsents.complain: Questions or complaints: our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, {{grievanceEmail}}. You can also go to the Data Protection Board of India.
